title: Studios
intro: Every station on the platform. Each studio broadcasts in one language, and the language picker decides which studio people hear.
actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

actions.label: Actions for {{name}}
actions.lastActive: At least one studio must stay on air

create.title: New studio
create.languageHint: The studio broadcasts in this language. It can't be changed later.
create.ownerHint: Optional. You can also add people later from the studio's settings.
create.permanentHint: The studio uses the platform audio format (bitrate, sample rate, channels) so tracks and live shows play back smoothly. Its media folder and encoder credentials are created for you.
create.done: {{name}} is ready. Upload music and share the encoder credentials to go on air.
create.noneAvailable: Every supported language already has a studio.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: The stream goes off air within 5 minutes and current listeners are disconnected. Listeners of this language hear the default studio instead. Members lose access until it is reactivated. Music, members and statistics are kept.

activate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
activate.body: The stream comes back on air within 5 minutes with its music, members and settings as they were.
